faq.a: Senay is associated with the Arabic form ثَنَاي, whose core sense is senay; praise (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Senay?
faq.a: Senay is associated with Arabic. Senay is the Turkish form of Arabic ثَنَاء (Thanāʾ), meaning 'praise'.
Yes — the underlying form ثَنَاي is Arabic.
Senay can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Senay should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Thanāʾ is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Senay mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Senay is rendered ثنائے and carries the sense ثنائے، تعریف.

faq.q: What does Senay mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Senay is rendered ثنای and carries the sense ثنای، ستایش.
A romanized syllable approximation is se-nay. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Senay?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Senay, senay. Script forms are ثنائے, ثناي, ثنای, ثَنَاي, सनाय.

faq.q: Is Senay a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
